At Animal Hospital of Statesville and our new office, Animal Hospital on South Main, we feel it is important to educate our clients to enable them to provide the happiest, healthiest and longest life possible for their pets. We are working to include lots of educational and instructional videos for our clients - from services we provide to things they can learn to do for themselves to help maintain their pet's wellness.  All our videos are closed captioned. All you need to do is click CC at the bottom of the videos, though a good portion of the 2024 videos have embedded captions, so they should come on automatically!
Animal Hospital of Statesville is an 8-doctor practice with highly trained RVTs, VPC Team, CSRs and all-star Resort & Spa Guest Services Technicians (GSAs). We offer a variety of advanced health care plans, medical procedures and techniques to help you keep your pet in tip-top shape throughout their life!
